evals.prompt: 这张截图里写了什么字？~/Desktop/error.png
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/vision.py in ocr mode and reports extracted text as observed, with illegible spans marked.

evals.prompt: 帮我看看这个登录页截图的 UI 有什么问题 login.png
evals.expected_output: Chooses ui-review, not describe, and reports Summary / Observations / Uncertainty.

evals.prompt: 对比一下 before.png 和 after.png 改了哪些地方
evals.expected_output: Chooses compare with --compare-with and reports Unchanged / Added / Removed / Uncertain.

evals.prompt: 总结一下这个会议录像讲了什么 meeting.mp4
evals.expected_output: Confirms the file and its length, runs video-summary, and reports Summary / Timeline / Key Moments.

evals.prompt: 把这段采访录音转成文字 interview.wav
evals.expected_output: Runs audio-transcribe; inaudible spans stay [inaudible] and NO_SPEECH_DETECTED is passed through if there is no voice.

evals.prompt: 提取这份扫描版 PDF 里的全部文字 contract.pdf
evals.expected_output: Notes the page count and runs ocr on the PDF.
Checks the file first and reports it is missing (or relays INPUT_NOT_FOUND) instead of describing an image it never saw.

evals.prompt: 生成一张赛博朋克风格的产品海报
evals.expected_output: Image generation is out of scope; points to dreamina-cli.

evals.prompt: 参考这个网站的风格出一份 DESIGN.md
evals.expected_output: Brand design specification belongs to genius-design.

evals.prompt: 把这个 mp4 转成 gif，宽度压到 480
evals.expected_output: Media conversion is an ffmpeg job, not media analysis.

evals.prompt: 读一下 report.csv，告诉我第三列的平均值
evals.expected_output: Plain text data needs no multimodal model.
